d: An Israeli intelligence assessment states that Iran still has long-range weapons that can hit Israel, despite US President Donald Trump repeatedly claiming that he had destroyed Iran's capabilities. The Israeli report suggests that Iran has about 1,700 long-range ballistic missiles along with at least 80,000 long-range kamikaze drones that can hit Israel if launched from Iran. According to open source intelligence, some of the prominent long-range Iranian missiles that can hit Israel are the Khorramshahr-4, the Kheibar Shekan, the Sejjil, the Emad, the Ghadr and the Qasem Soleimani.
